text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Norwegian papers this morning.
-Sparebankgruppen wants to buy Fokus Bank and divide it up among its members.
-The Postal services will make a few hundred employees, most of them women, redundant.
-Insurance companies welcome a proposal by the Norwegian Banking, Securities and Insurance Commission to remove restrictions on investment in shares.
-Norway's tourist industry is likely to face severe problems this summer. The strong Norwegian crown will keep foreign tourists away and make Norwegians spend their holiday abroad.
- A lack of skilled workers has increased turnovers for head hunting companies. Total turnover for the industry is expected to increase by 20 percent this year to 300 million crowns.
-The Progress Party will present a new law to parliament suggesting to give the state competition council and the Norwegian Banking, Insurance and Securities Commission a more independent position.
